You use your thralls to restore yourself. Destroy up to three of your thralls within 60 feet and regain Hit Points equal to your level per thrall destroyed. If you destroy three thralls total, you can also decrease one of your clumsy, enfeebled, frightened, sickened, or stupefied condition values by 1.

items.name: Zombie Horde (Necromancer)
items.summary: You raise what seems like an endless torrent of walking corpses.
items.description: You raise what seems like an endless torrent of walking corpses. You learn the Zombie Horde grave spell.

items.name: Conglomerate of Limbs
items.summary: You call forth a lumbering mass of fleshy limbs.
items.description: You call forth a lumbering mass of fleshy limbs. You learn the Conglomerate of Limbs grave spell.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Conglomerate of Limbs

items.name: Final Spite
items.summary: You can trigger this action even while dying.
items.description:
**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Trigger** A creature reduces you or a living ally within 30 feet to 0 Hit Points.

You can trigger this action even while dying. You can channel the power of death into a poisonous spite. The triggering creature takes 4d4 persistent poison damage with a basic Fortitude save against your spell DC. If the creature kills you or your ally as part of the trigger, the creature gets a result one degree of success worse than it rolls on this save.

items.name: Infuse Void
items.summary: If the next action you use is to cast a grave spell that deals damage, creatures damaged by the spell take additional void damage equal to the rank of the spell.
items.description: If the next action you use is to cast a grave spell that deals damage, creatures damaged by the spell take additional void damage equal to the rank of the spell. If this void damage or the spell reduces one or more creatures to 0 Hit Points, you regain 1 Focus Point. You can regain a Focus Point this way only once per 10 minutes.

items.name: March of the Dead
items.summary: You compel your horde of thralls, overwhelming your enemies.
items.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You compel your horde of thralls, overwhelming your enemies. You command any number of thralls within 60 feet to Stride. After all their movement is complete, any enemy adjacent to three or more thralls must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw against your spell DC or become encumbered and Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: March of the Dead

items.name: Poison Drinker
items.summary: You temporarily transform your digestive system to instead gain a burst of sustenance from the poison you ingest.
items.description:
**Trigger** You critically succeed on a Fortitude save against a poison effect.

You temporarily transform your digestive system to instead gain a burst of sustenance from the poison you ingest. You regain Hit Points equal to the level of the poison (or double the spell's rank if the poison was caused by a spell), and you gain as much nourishment as one square meal.

items.name: Sanguine Transference
items.summary: You transfer your blood and soul into a thrall.
items.description: You transfer your blood and soul into a thrall. You learn the Sanguine Transference grave spell.

items.name: Wings of Bone and Sinew
items.summary: You can harness the power of death to craft wings from bones and a thin membrane of flesh.
items.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

You can harness the power of death to craft wings from bones and a thin membrane of flesh. You destroy a thrall within 30 feet, fusing it with your body and shaping it into gruesome, bony wings. You gain a fly Speed of 30 feet for 1 minute. You can Dismiss these wings. At 16th level, this action loses its frequency and gains an unlimited duration.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Wings of Bone and Sinew

items.name: Blossoming Gore
items.summary: You create a field of bloody roses.
items.description: You create a field of bloody roses. You learn the Blossoming Gore grave spell.

items.name: Desperate Surge
items.summary: You can conjure up at will the kind of strength that most beings only attain in life-or-death situations.
items.description:
**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

You can conjure up at will the kind of strength that most beings only attain in life-or-death situations. You can attempt to Grapple, Reposition, Shove, or Trip a creature using a spell attack roll instead of an Athletics check.

You can recharge this ability early by making an unarmed Strike to destroy one of your thralls within your reach.

items.name: Expanded Necromancy
items.summary: You delve into other magical traditions.
items.description:
You delve into other magical traditions. Add the Grisly Growths spell to your dirge. Add the following spells to your dirge as soon as you gain the ability to cast necromancer spells of that rank:

- **7th:** Execute
- **8th:** Desiccate
- **9th:** Massacre

You can prepare and cast these spells as occult spells.

items.name: Necromantic Lifesense
items.summary: Your connection to life and death allows you to sense the life force of a creature with a glance.
items.description:
Your connection to life and death allows you to sense the life force of a creature with a glance. You gain lifesense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet. This allows you to sense the life force of living and undead creatures within the listed range. The sense can distinguish between the vitality energy animating living creatures and the void energy animating undead creatures, much as sight distinguishes colors.

Additionally, you know the current Hit Points and temporary Hit Points of any living or undead creature you can see within 30 feet.

items.name: Overburdening Spell
items.summary: You have learned how to weigh down your enemies' life essence.
items.description:
You have learned how to weigh down your enemies' life essence. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that targets a single creature, unless the target is unaffected by the spell, the target takes a –15-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 round (this penalty is doubled for climb, fly, and swim Speeds).

Effect: Overburdening Spell

items.name: Skeletal Extension
items.summary: You make use of what remains of a thrall to extend your limbs to unnatural lengths.
items.description:
You make use of what remains of a thrall to extend your limbs to unnatural lengths. If the next action you take is to cast a grave spell that destroys a thrall, pieces of the thrall fuse with you to extend the length of your limbs. Until the end of the turn, your reach increases by 10 feet, and you can move 15 feet whenever you Step.

Effect: Skeletal Extension

items.name: Speak With Days Long Dead
items.summary: You channel the essences and echoes of spirits long dead that reside within a location, an object, or a bloodline.
items.description:
You channel the essences and echoes of spirits long dead that reside within a location, an object, or a bloodline. You spend 10 minutes and must be within the location, be able to touch a piece of the object, or drink a drop of blood of the bloodline as appropriate to the spirits you wish to channel. You learn one piece of information or about one significant event relating directly to the location, object, or bloodline that has occurred within the last year. You can channel any given target only once every 24 hours.

At 12th level, you can learn about information or events that took place within the last decade, within the last century if you are 16th level, or at any point in history at 20th level.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Speak With Days Long Dead

items.name: Become as Spirit
items.summary: You can move through an unwilling creature's spaces as if they were difficult terrain.
items.description:
You can move through an unwilling creature's spaces as if they were difficult terrain. Additionally, you ignore natural difficult terrain and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Escape attempts. Whenever you destroy a thrall, you gain resistance to all damage (except force, ghost touch, spirit, or vitality) equal to half your level for 1 round.

Effect: Become as Spirit
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Become as Spirit

items.name: Bridge of Graves
items.summary: You create a massive line of grave dirt that thralls can easily traverse.
items.description: You create a massive line of grave dirt that thralls can easily traverse. You learn the Bridge of Graves grave spell.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Bridge of Graves

items.name: Endless Return
items.summary: You can return your enemies as thralls without a second thought.
items.description: You can return your enemies as thralls without a second thought. At the start of each of your turns, you gain an additional reaction that you can use only for Inevitable Return.

items.name: Grave Focus
items.summary: Studying necromancy in great depth has perfected your ability to find the links between life and death where you least expected.
items.description: Studying necromancy in great depth has perfected your ability to find the links between life and death where you least expected. Whenever you Refocus, completely refill your focus pool.

items.name: Reinforced Skeleton
items.summary: You take on the toughness and lightness of bone.
items.description:
You take on the toughness and lightness of bone. You gain resistance equal to half your level to two damage types; one is your choice of cold, electricity, or fire, and the other is your choice of slashing or piercing. You also gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Speeds. Whenever you destroy a thrall, this bonus to your Speeds increases to +10 feet for 1 round.

Effect: Reinforced Skeleton

items.name: Sanguine Mastery
items.summary: Your mastery over the intricacies of your fascination has allowed you to infuse your own blood with additional healing properties while increasing your ability to bleed out any foes that stand…
items.description:
Your mastery over the intricacies of your fascination has allowed you to infuse your own blood with additional healing properties while increasing your ability to bleed out any foes that stand against you. You gain resistance to bleed damage equal to half your level. Additionally, if an enemy within 30 feet of you is bleeding, you gain fast healing equal to half your level. This fast healing is deactivated while you have the dying condition.

In addition, whenever you destroy a thrall, a creature adjacent to the thrall takes 1 bleed damage. If that creature is already taking bleed damage, instead increase its bleed damage by 1. A creature can have its bleed damage increased in this way only once per round.

items.name: Thick Skin
items.summary: You thicken your skin by adding an impossibly thin layer of dense muscle directly under the surface.
items.description: You thicken your skin by adding an impossibly thin layer of dense muscle directly under the surface. Increase your maximum Hit Points by your level. The first time each round you destroy a thrall, each enemy adjacent to you must succeed at a Fortitude save against your spell DC or become Sickened 1.

items.name: Amalgamate
items.summary: You create a single mighty abomination using the pieces of two expendable thralls.
items.description: You create a single mighty abomination using the pieces of two expendable thralls. You destroy two of your thralls within 30 feet that are adjacent to each other, fusing them into an amalgamation. An amalgamation is a single Large thrall with a reach of 10 feet and a Speed of 25 feet. It gains a status bonus to damage rolls on its Strikes equal to your level.

items.name: Blood Pool
items.summary: You use the lifeblood of your enemies to heal your allies.
items.description:
**Trigger** A creature with blood within 30 feet of you dies or takes bleed damage.

You use the lifeblood of your enemies to heal your allies. You pool the blood of the creature on the ground in a space adjacent to the triggering creature, infusing it with healing properties. The pool lasts for 1 minute or until absorbed by an ally. When an ally enters a space with a blood pool, they can absorb the blood pool as a free action, regaining Hit Points equal to your level.

items.name: Instinctual Creation
items.summary: You have trained to never be caught without some semblance of necromantic defense.
items.description:
**Trigger** You roll initiative.

You have trained to never be caught without some semblance of necromantic defense. You create two thralls in spaces adjacent to you.

items.name: Ocular Flesh
items.summary: You create a fleshy eyeball that is the size of a marble.
items.description:
You create a fleshy eyeball that is the size of a marble. You can take a single action, which has the concentrate trait, to look through any of your eyeballs until the start of your next turn. An eyeball can be manipulated like a marble, such as being rolled or thrown. One can also be affixed to a surface, for example a wall, with 1 minute's work. An eyeball lasts for 24 hours, and you can maintain a total of three eyeballs at any given time. Creating a fourth destroys the oldest eyeball.

Eyeballs are very small but are easy to spot. A creature actively Seeking or Searching automatically finds an eyeball. They're also not very sturdy and can be destroyed with an Interact action.

items.name: Recurring Nightmare
items.summary: You summon a lingering spirit that just won't stay dead.
items.description: You summon a lingering spirit that just won't stay dead. You learn the Recurring Nightmare grave spell.

items.name: Skeletal Lancers
items.summary: You create a myriad of swift skeletal warriors.
items.description: You create a myriad of swift skeletal warriors. You learn the Skeletal Lancers grave spell.

items.name: Unholy Resurrection
items.summary: You can bring back the recently deceased, but at what cost?
items.description: You can bring back the recently deceased, but at what cost? You add Raise Dead to your dirge and can cast it as an occult spell. However, when you Cast this Spell, the returned creature gains the undead trait. (The creature knows it will return as undead when it decides whether to return.) Only powerful magic such as a Wish ritual can return the target to true life again. You gain an additional spell slot each day at your highest rank of necromancer spell slots. You can prepare only the *raise dead* spell in this slot.

items.name: Anatomical Quartering
items.summary: You briefly separate into four forms that share your space.
items.description: You briefly separate into four forms that share your space. One is made of blood, one of bones, one of flesh, and one of spirit. Make up to four Strikes, each against a different target. All physical damage from the final Strike instead becomes spirit damage. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but you don't increase your penalty until you have made all your attacks.

items.name: Beckoning Dirge
items.summary: Your dirge beckons, overflowing into a thrall within 60 feet.
items.description:
**Frequency** once per day

Your dirge beckons, overflowing into a thrall within 60 feet. This turn, you can Cast one Spell that's in your dirge without spending a spell slot or even having it prepared. The maximum rank of this spell is 1 rank lower than your highest-rank necromancer spell slot. The chosen thrall becomes the point of origin for your spell, and you calculate range and cover from its space instead of yours. The thrall is then destroyed.

items.name: Desperate Revival
items.summary: On the verge of death, you drain the life of all around you in a desperate attempt to remain alive.
items.description:
**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed.

On the verge of death, you drain the life of all around you in a desperate attempt to remain alive. You avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point. Each creature in a 60-foot emanation must attempt a Fortitude saving throw against your spell DC. You regain Hit Points equal to the total damage dealt, up to a maximum of half your maximum Hit Points.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target takes void damage equal to half its level.

**Failure** The target takes void damage equal to its level.

**Critical Failure** The target takes void damage equal to double its level.

items.name: Flesh Tsunami
items.summary: You unleash a wave of melted flesh.
items.description: You unleash a wave of melted flesh. You learn the Flesh Tsunami grave spell.

items.name: Temporary Possession
items.summary: You temporarily possess of a creature's body.
items.description: You temporarily possess of a creature's body. You learn the Temporary Possession grave spell.

items.name: Calcification
items.summary: You attempt to turn a creature into pure bone.
items.description: You attempt to turn a creature into pure bone. You learn the Calcification grave spell.

items.name: Dread Mosquito Storm
items.summary: You release a massive swarm of deadly bloodsuckers.
items.description: You release a massive swarm of deadly bloodsuckers. You learn the Dread Mosquito Storm grave spell.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Dread Mosquito Storm

items.name: Ectoplasmic Aura
items.summary: For the next 10 minutes, you and all allies in a 30-foot emanation from you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC as the air between you and your enemies thickens with ectoplasm.
items.description: For the next 10 minutes, you and all allies in a 30-foot emanation from you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC as the air between you and your enemies thickens with ectoplasm. Additionally, any enemy that ends its turn in this aura must attempt a Fortitude saving throw against your spell DC. On a failure, it can't use reactions until the start of its next turn. You can Dismiss this aura.

items.name: Power Hungry
items.summary: You focus your hunger, allowing you to consume even more power from your thralls.
items.description: You focus your hunger, allowing you to consume even more power from your thralls. Whenever you destroy three thralls with Reclaim Power, you completely refill your focus pool.

items.name: Reanimate Foe
items.summary: You attempt to bring a creature back to life to fight by your side.
items.description: You attempt to bring a creature back to life to fight by your side. You learn the Reanimate Foe grave spell.

items.name: Final Union
items.summary: You and the heroic spirit have formed an eternal pact and now share your body.
items.description:
You and the heroic spirit have formed an eternal pact and now share your body. You are constantly under the effect of a 10th-rank Bind Heroic Spirit. You choose whether the heroic spirit remains as a separate entity bound to you or whether you become a fused spirit that lives in unison, possibly identifying as an entirely new person.

You gain the Additional Lore feat for a topic the spirit knew in life, usually Warfare Lore.

If you would fall unconscious, you don't fall prone or drop any items. Instead, your heroic spirit takes control of your body, allowing you to perform actions as if you were still conscious. If you would die, your heroic spirit puppets your corpse for up to 1 minute after your death or until your body is destroyed. While dead, you are an undead object, granting you immunities to bleed, death effects, disease, healing, nonlethal attacks, poison, and void, as well as the doomed, drained, fatigued, sickened, and unconscious conditions. As an object, you have 200 Hit Points and a Broken Threshold of 100 Hit Points. While broken, you are Slowed 1. If you are destroyed, your body must be mended before you can be brought back to life. A creature can spend 8 hours to attempt a DC 45 Crafting check, mending your body on a success. Alternatively, powerful magic such as the Remake spell or the Wish ritual can also be used to mend your body.

items.name: Instant Army
items.summary: You keep a reserve cache of thralls ready in case of an emergency.
items.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You keep a reserve cache of thralls ready in case of an emergency. You create up to 20 thralls within 120 feet.

items.name: Living Graveyard
items.summary: You conjure forth a massive, animated graveyard.
items.description: You conjure forth a massive, animated graveyard. You learn the Living Graveyard grave spell.

items.name: Mortem Ultimatum
items.summary: You have discovered the greatest secrets of life and death.
items.description: You have discovered the greatest secrets of life and death. You gain an additional 10th-rank spell slot.

items.name: Perfected Thrall
items.summary: Using your accumulated knowledge of all forms of necromancy, you create the perfect thrall.
items.description: Using your accumulated knowledge of all forms of necromancy, you create the perfect thrall. You learn the Perfected Thrall grave spell.

items.name: Soul Thief
items.summary: You attempt to steal the soul of a creature that was at least 18th level that died within the last minute.
items.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You attempt to steal the soul of a creature that was at least 18th level that died within the last minute. Attempt an Occultism check against the hard DC of the target's level. On a success, you capture its soul and solidify it into a gem that keeps the soul contained. While the soul is contained, it can't be returned to life through any means, even powerful magic such as the Wish ritual. If a gem is destroyed, the soul is freed, and you become alerted to its destruction. You can maintain only three gems at any given time. If you attempt to make a fourth, you must choose a soul to be released.

You can consume a captured soul by swallowing a gem. Doing so grants you the unholy and undead traits and extends your existence by 50 years. You gain void healing, you aren't instantly destroyed when reduced to 0 Hit Points, and you can't be instantly killed by death effects. If you're destroyed, you can rebuild yourself in the location of one of your soul gems. This consumes the gem, and it takes 24 hours for your body to be rebuilt. If you are ever destroyed and are unable to rebuild your body, all souls that you have consumed are released.

Effect: Soul Thief

items.name: Ancestral Mind
items.summary: By unraveling memories and connections passed down from your progenitors and buried within your unconscious mind, you learn to convert your inherent magic into psychic power.
items.description: By unraveling memories and connections passed down from your progenitors and buried within your unconscious mind, you learn to convert your inherent magic into psychic power. You can cast any innate spells you know from an ancestry feat or heritage using your psychic spellcasting and thoughtforms. When you do so, the spell's tradition becomes occult, if it wasn't already, and you can use your psychic spellcasting attribute modifier instead of Charisma to determine your spell attack modifier and spell DC.

items.name: Counter Thought
items.summary: When a foe Casts a Spell that has the mental trait and you can see its manifestations, you can use your own mental magic to disrupt it.
items.description:
**Trigger** A creature Casts a Spell with the mental trait.

**Requirements** You have an unexpended spell slot you could use to Cast a Spell with the mental trait.

When a foe Casts a Spell that has the mental trait and you can see its manifestations, you can use your own mental magic to disrupt it. You expend one of your spell slots to counter the triggering creature's casting of a spell with the mental trait. You lose your spell slot as if you had cast the triggering spell; this spell slot must be one for which you could Cast a Spell with the mental trait. You then attempt to counteract the triggering spell.

items.name: Mental Buffer
items.summary: Your mind deflects some amount of harm from attacks that induce pain or manipulate your mind directly.
items.description: Your mind deflects some amount of harm from attacks that induce pain or manipulate your mind directly. You gain resistance to mental damage equal to half your level (minimum 1). This resistance increases to equal to your level while your Psyche is Unleashed.

items.name: Psychic Rapport
items.summary: Your telepathic sensitivity intensifies when you're affected by mental magic, making it easier for you to link to other creatures.
items.description:
Your telepathic sensitivity intensifies when you're affected by mental magic, making it easier for you to link to other creatures. After you Cast a Spell with the mental trait, until the start of your next turn, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception, Diplomacy, and Intimidation checks, and to Perception checks to Sense Motive.

Effect: Psychic Rapport

items.name: Mental Balm
items.summary: Your spells release soothing mental waves.
items.description:
Your spells release soothing mental waves. Use this amp in place of a psi cantrip's normal amp entry. You can use this amp only on a psi cantrip that targets or affects you or one or more of your allies and doesn't target or affect any enemies.

**Amp** You or one ally within 30 feet gains a +2 status bonus to Will saves against emotion effects for 1 minute. You can also have the amped psi cantrip attempt to counteract one effect imposing the frightened condition on yourself or the chosen ally, or an effect imposing the stupefied condition that has a duration of 1 hour or less. If you successfully counteract the effect, you remove only the frightened and stupefied conditions, not any other part of the effect.

items.name: Psi Burst
items.summary: With a passing thought, you direct violent psychic energies at a nearby creature.
items.description:
**Frequency** once per round

With a passing thought, you direct violent psychic energies at a nearby creature. Target one creature within 30 feet. It takes (1d4 per 2 levels) bludgeoning damage with a basic Reflex save. At 3rd level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d4.

items.name: Warp Space
items.summary: You use your magic to bend space, causing your spell to strike from a strange vector.
items.description:
You use your magic to bend space, causing your spell to strike from a strange vector. Use this amp in place of a psi cantrip's normal amp entry. The amped psi cantrip must have a range.

**Amp** Choose a square within 30 feet to which you have line of effect and line of sight. Determine your spell's line of effect and line of sight from there, as well as whether creatures have cover against the spell. The spell can exceed its normal range as measured from you, as long as it's within its normal range from the square you chose.

items.name: Astral Tether
items.summary: You spin out a thread of psychic energy that connects you to an ally, using it as a conduit for your abilities.
items.description:
You spin out a thread of psychic energy that connects you to an ally, using it as a conduit for your abilities. Choose a willing creature within 60 feet and connect to it. Whenever you would gain a benefit from a psychic amp, you can have the amp affect the tethered creature instead. You can do so only if the amp grants a distinct benefit, not if it alters the amped spell.

The tether can't be severed physically but breaks if the distance between you and the tethered ally ever exceeds 60 feet, if you become unconscious, or if you use Astral Tether again.

items.name: Homing Beacon
items.summary: As your spell strikes a target, you plant a beacon in the target's mind that announces its presence to those nearby.
items.description:
As your spell strikes a target, you plant a beacon in the target's mind that announces its presence to those nearby. Use this amp in place of a psi cantrip's normal amp entry. The amped cantrip must be one that has one or more targets and must either require a spell attack roll or have a saving throw.

**Amp** Choose one creature hit by the spell (if the spell has a spell attack roll) or that fails its save against the spell (if the spell requires a save). A psychic beacon emits from the creature's location, making it easier to notice the creature as the mind and attention of onlookers is subtly drawn to it. For 1 minute, if the target would be invisible, it's instead merely concealed, and if it would be concealed, it's no longer concealed.

items.name: Psi Strikes
items.summary: You siphon residual psychic energies from your spell into one weapon you're wielding or one of your unarmed attacks and when you unleash your mind, the energies flare to match.
items.description:
**Frequency** once per turn

**Requirements** Your most recent action was to Cast a Spell or to Unleash your Psyche.

You siphon residual psychic energies from your spell into one weapon you're wielding or one of your unarmed attacks and when you unleash your mind, the energies flare to match. The attack deals an extra 1d6 force damage until the end of the current turn. If your Psyche is Unleashed, this benefit instead lasts until your psyche subsides.

items.name: Thoughtform Summoning
items.summary: You can create a prototypical creature from the depths of your imagination instead of calling one from elsewhere.
items.description:
You can create a prototypical creature from the depths of your imagination instead of calling one from elsewhere. Whenever you summon a creature, you can choose to instead create a psychic construct of that creature. This grants it resistance to physical damage equal to half its level, weakness 5 to force and mental damage, and the ability to pass through enemies' spaces without needing to Tumble Through (though it can't end its turn in an occupied space).

Effect: Thoughtform Summoning

items.name: Violent Unleash
items.summary: The force of your mind unleashing itself wracks your enemies with a violent shockwave that batters your enemies.
items.description:
**Requirement** Your previous action was to Unleash your Psyche.

The force of your mind unleashing itself wracks your enemies with a violent shockwave that batters your enemies. You deal (1d6 per 2 levels) force damage to all creatures in a 20-foot emanation, with a basic Reflex save.

At 5th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d6.

items.name: Inertial Barrier
items.summary: Your spell leaves behind barriers that reduce shock and motion.
items.description:
Your spell leaves behind barriers that reduce shock and motion. Use this amp in place of a psi cantrip's normal amp entry.

**Amp** You or one target of the spell gains resistance to physical damage equal to 2 + the spell's rank until the start of your next turn.

Effect: Inertial Barrier

items.name: Parallel Breakthrough
items.summary: You expand your mind beyond your area of psychic specialty.
items.description: You expand your mind beyond your area of psychic specialty. You gain a 1st-rank psi cantrip for a conscious mind other than your own; this can be either the unique surface cantrip or one of the common cantrips and the accompanying amp. If you choose a common cantrip, you also gain the special benefit granted by that conscious mind when casting the cantrip without an amp. You don't gain any other benefits of that conscious mind, such as additional spells known.

items.name: Sixth Sense
items.summary: Your psychic abilities also allow you to detect the lingering thoughts of spirits and similar entities.
items.description:
Your psychic abilities also allow you to detect the lingering thoughts of spirits and similar entities. While you're exploring but not Searching, the GM rolls a secret check for you to find haunts that usually require Searching, as well as spirits, creatures on the Ethereal Plane, and beings made entirely of spiritual essence, such as celestials, fiends, and monitors.

You can also potentially notice ethereal creatures and spirits inside solid objects, provided they are within 30 feet of you. This applies while Searching, Seeking, and on the automatic secret check from Sixth Sense. You can still notice spirits only on a successful check, and you can't see them if they're more than 5 feet inside an object.

When you notice a creature with your Sixth Sense, you also learn its location, making it hidden to you if it had been undetected.

items.name: Strain Mind
items.summary: You strain your body beyond its limits to use an amp even when your mental power is depleted.
items.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

**Trigger** You cast a psi cantrip.

**Requirements** You have 0 Focus Points.

You strain your body beyond its limits to use an amp even when your mental power is depleted. You add an amp that costs 1 Focus Point to the spell. Instead of paying the normal Focus Point cost, you lose Hit Points equal to four times the spell rank of the amped psi cantrip as you bleed from your nose or suffer some other visible sign of strain.

items.name: Brain Drain
items.summary: With a wresting of will, you siphon off a creature's mental energy to replenish your own.
items.description:
With a wresting of will, you siphon off a creature's mental energy to replenish your own. One non-mindless creature within 30 feet must attempt a Will save against your spell DC.

**Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Failure** The creature is Stupefied 1 for 1 minute, and you regain 1 Focus Point, up to your normal maximum. You can't use Brain Drain again until after the next time you make your daily preparations.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the creature is Stupefied 2.

items.name: Dark Persona's Presence
items.summary: When you Unleash your Psyche, all your rage and pain-the portion of your psyche dedicated to cruel retribution-come along with it.
items.description:
**Trigger** You Unleash your Psyche.

When you Unleash your Psyche, all your rage and pain-the portion of your psyche dedicated to cruel retribution-come along with it.

The force of your dark persona's negativity batters constantly against all creatures in a 30-foot emanation when you Unleash your Psyche and for as long as your Psyche is Unleashed. A creature must attempt a Will save against your spell DC the first time it enters the emanation, or if it's in the emanation when you take this action; it doesn't need to attempt a save again, even if it leaves the emanation and returns. A creature frightened by your Dark Persona's Presence can't decrease its frightened value below 1 while within the emanation.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The target is Frightened 1.

**Failure** The target is Frightened 2.

**Critical Failure** The target is Frightened 3.

While your Psyche is Unleashed, your dark persona cares only for destruction. You can Cast a Spell only if it can directly damage an enemy or object or can impose a detrimental condition or penalty on one.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Dark Persona's Presence

items.name: Remove Presence
items.summary: Your spell reaches into the mind of a creature and removes you from it.
items.description:
Your spell reaches into the mind of a creature and removes you from it. The amped cantrip must be one that has one or more targets and must either require a spell attack roll or have a saving throw. Use this amp in place of the psi cantrip's normal amp entry.

**Amp** Choose one target of the spell or one creature in its area. If that enemy fails its save or the spell hits it, you become undetected by that creature, disappearing from its senses for 1 minute or until you use a hostile action. This is similar to being invisible, but effects like *see the unseen*don't reveal you-you're affecting the target's mind, not its vision. *Truesight* can still see through this illusion if the counteract check succeeds.

items.name: Thoughtsense
items.summary: You can detect the flickers of mental activity let off by all thinking creatures.
items.description:
You can detect the flickers of mental activity let off by all thinking creatures. You gain Thoughtsense as a vague sense that has a range of 30 feet-like all vague senses, it's only about as precise as an average human's sense of smell, meaning you generally can predict only if a creature is present. Your thoughtsense detects only thinking creatures, so a creature that is unthinking or otherwise immune to mental effects (such as many constructs and oozes) can't be perceived using your thoughtsense, regardless of how precise it is.

While your Psyche is Unleashed, your thoughtsense upgrades to an imprecise sense, letting you use it to Seek out creatures.

items.name: Whispering Steps
items.summary: Your spell leaves a lingering connection between you and a creature-one through which you can nudge the creature's mind this way or that.
items.description:
Your spell leaves a lingering connection between you and a creature-one through which you can nudge the creature's mind this way or that. The amped cantrip must take 2 or more actions to cast, target one or more creatures, and either require a spell attack roll or have a saving throw. Use this amp in place of the psi cantrip's normal amp entry.

**Amp** Choose one enemy who is a target of the spell. If that enemy fails its save or the spell hits it, you whisper in the creature's mind, forcing it to Stride up to half its Speed in a direction of your choosing; as this is forced movement, you can't force the creature to move into hazardous terrain, off a ledge, or the like. After it moves, the creature becomes temporarily immune to this amp for 24 hours.

items.name: Dream Guise
items.summary: You Stride into a willing ally's space, at which point both of your appearances shift into a shared third appearance, usually one that looks like a mix of the two of you.
items.description: You Stride into a willing ally's space, at which point both of your appearances shift into a shared third appearance, usually one that looks like a mix of the two of you. Then, either you or your ally Strides. You each maintain the merged appearance. Creatures who are observing this know what happened, but still must Seek or otherwise engage with the illusion to attempt to disbelieve it and determine which of you is which. Otherwise, they can't tell the difference and have an equal chance to target each of you (DC 11 flat). This illusion ends as soon as either you or the ally you're merged with acts.

items.name: Emotional Surge
items.summary: Your heart soars, increasing your power for a moment.
items.description: Your heart soars, increasing your power for a moment. You gain a +2 status bonus to attack rolls and skill checks until the start of your next turn.

items.name: Impose Order (Psychic)
items.summary: You bring discipline to your mind and magic, ensuring that you don't under-perform.
items.description: You bring discipline to your mind and magic, ensuring that you don't under-perform. Until the end of your turn, instead of rolling dice for damage, count each damage die as average damage rounded up (3 for d4, 4 for d6, 5 for d8, 6 for d10, and 7 for d12).

items.name: Scour the Library
items.summary: Seeing an enemy's attack, you quickly consult multiple scraps of lore in your mind, synthesizing them into the perfect plan.
items.description: Seeing an enemy's attack, you quickly consult multiple scraps of lore in your mind, synthesizing them into the perfect plan. Make a check to Recall Knowledge (using an appropriate skill) about one creature within 60 feet. On a success, in addition to the normal benefits, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your next attack roll against that creature and to your AC against the creature's next attack. On a critical success, the bonuses are +2.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Scour the Library

items.name: Signature Spell Expansion (Psychic)
items.summary: Your direct mental grasp of your power lets you cast more spells with greater freedom.
items.description: Your direct mental grasp of your power lets you cast more spells with greater freedom. You gain two additional signature spells, each of which must have a minimum rank of 3rd or lower.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Signature Spell Expansion (Psychic)

items.name: Amp Focus
items.summary: You've glimpsed the furthest recesses of your mind.
items.description: You've glimpsed the furthest recesses of your mind. When you Refocus, you regain all your Focus Points (even if you spent them on something other than amps).

items.name: Foreseen Failure
items.summary: You see your spell fail to take hold to disastrous end, then snap back to reality—it was all a precognition, and you know to try a different spell.
items.description:
**Frequency** once per day

**Trigger** A spell you cast has no effect because you critically failed all your spell attack rolls or because all targets critically succeeded at their saving throws.

You see your spell fail to take hold to disastrous end, then snap back to reality—it was all a precognition, and you know to try a different spell. Your spell is expended, but you can Cast a Spell that requires the same number of actions as the triggering spell or fewer to cast. The second spell must be a different spell than the first.

items.name: No!!!
items.summary: The shock of seeing your ally near death breaks whatever limits exist in your mind, sending your power spilling forth.
items.description:
**Trigger** A non-minion ally within 60 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

The shock of seeing your ally near death breaks whatever limits exist in your mind, sending your power spilling forth. If your psyche is currently unleashed, you can immediately use a psyche action that takes 1 action or less to use. If your psyche is not currently unleashed, you Unleash your Psyche, which remains unleashed until the end of your next turn. You can ignore Unleash Psyche's requirement of needing to have Cast a Spell on your previous turn, but you still can't Unleash your Psyche if you're stupefied or for 2 rounds after your psyche subsides.

items.name: Psi Catastrophe
items.summary: You stop holding your power back, unleashing it all in a catastrophic blast.
items.description: You stop holding your power back, unleashing it all in a catastrophic blast. All creatures in a 20-foot emanation take 1d6 bludgeoning damage per level with a basic Reflex. Your psyche subsides as your power is expended.

items.name: Conscious Spell Specialization
items.summary: You become more adept with the spells that are always in your mind.
items.description: You become more adept with the spells that are always in your mind. You gain an additional spell slot of 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 4th ranks. You can use these spell slots to cast only a spell granted by your conscious mind. At 18th level, you also gain an additional 5th-rank spell slot, with the same restrictions.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Conscious Spell Specialization

items.name: Deep Roots
items.summary: Your mind-control spells send burrowing mental roots that tear at your target's mind when they're removed or run their course.
items.description: Your mind-control spells send burrowing mental roots that tear at your target's mind when they're removed or run their course. When you Cast a Spell that imposes the controlled condition or otherwise forces the target to take certain actions (such as Command), you can choose one target that critically failed its save. When that target finishes fulfilling any commands issued by your spell, or when the spell is dispelled or counteracted, the target takes 1d6 mental damage per rank of the spell.

items.name: Constant Levitation
items.summary: Your power has unbound you from the earth below.
items.description: Your power has unbound you from the earth below. You're affected by a constant Fly spell, and when your Psyche is Unleashed, you gain a +10-foot status bonus to your fly Speed.

items.name: Target of Psychic Ire
items.summary: Your magic saturates your surroundings with hateful psychic energy.
items.description:
Your magic saturates your surroundings with hateful psychic energy. Use this amp in place of a psi cantrip's normal amp entry. The cantrip must be one that takes 2 or more actions to cast and targets a creature.

**Amp** Choose one target of the spell. Psychic phenomena turn themselves on the target-typically, objects fling themselves at the creature. At the beginning of each of the target's turns, it takes 1d4 bludgeoning damage for each spell rank of the psi cantrip this amp was added to, with a basic Reflex save. The target remains marked by psychic ire for 3 rounds. The effect persists even if you fall unconscious or leave the area.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Target of Psychic Ire

items.name: Wandering Thoughts
items.summary: When your Psyche is Unleashed, each burst of magic you cast also folds space around you, and you travel through one of those folds.
items.description:
**Frequency** once per round

**Requirements** You used your most recent action to Cast a Spell.

When your Psyche is Unleashed, each burst of magic you cast also folds space around you, and you travel through one of those folds. You teleport 15 feet to a square you can see.

items.name: All in Your Head
items.summary: Flames scouring at your body, venom coursing through your veins-you refuse to believe they exist, and nothing can affect you if you don't believe in it.
items.description:
**Trigger** You're about to attempt a Fortitude save or a Reflex save.

Flames scouring at your body, venom coursing through your veins-you refuse to believe they exist, and nothing can affect you if you don't believe in it. You attempt a Will save against the triggering effect, instead of a Reflex or Fortitude save. You don't gain the benefits of Fortress of Will or Walls of Will on this save.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: All in Your Head

items.name: Cranial Detonation
items.summary: As your overwhelming psyche fells a creature, you use its flickering consciousness to detonate psychic energy from the creature's head.
items.description:
**Frequency** once per round

**Trigger** You successfully reduce one or more non-mindless enemies to 0 Hit Points with a spell.

As your overwhelming psyche fells a creature, you use its flickering consciousness to detonate psychic energy from the creature's head. Each enemy you reduced to 0 Hit Points dies and its head explodes. Each exploding head generates a shock wave in a 15-foot emanation around that enemy. Each creature in any of the emanations takes 10d6 bludgeoning damage with a basic Reflex. If this damage reduces an enemy to 0 Hit Points, its head also explodes, potentially damaging more creatures and potentially causing more detonations. A given creature can take damage only once from a single use of Cranial Detonation.

items.name: Twin Psyche
items.summary: You've segmented your psyche so it can operate in tandem.
items.description: You've segmented your psyche so it can operate in tandem. When you Unleash your Psyche, you can double its duration.

items.name: Autonomic Psychic Action
items.summary: Your power wants to be free.
items.description: Your power wants to be free. You're permanently quickened, and can use the additional action only for psyche actions.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Autonomic Psychic Action

items.name: Become Thought
items.summary: You shed some of your material form, becoming a being of pure thought.
items.description:
You shed some of your material form, becoming a being of pure thought. This has the following effects.

- You gain resistance 10 to physical damage but weakness 5 to mental damage.
- You can change your appearance on a whim. This takes a single action, which has the concentrate trait, has the effects of Illusory Disguise, and lasts until you change your appearance again.
- Once per year, when you die, you automatically return to life the next day as long as one living sentient creature on your plane remembers you; the memories enable you to reconstruct yourself from their thoughts. You appear in the vicinity of the creature that remembers you most strongly.

items.name: Mind Over Matter
items.summary: Your mind's limits are only what you imagine them to be.
items.description: Your mind's limits are only what you imagine them to be. You gain an additional 10th-rank spell slot.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Mind Over Matter

items.name: Unlimited Potential
items.summary: The laws of magic can limit your mind only if you think you need them, and you've grown past the need for such limits.
items.description:
**Frequency** once per minute

The laws of magic can limit your mind only if you think you need them, and you've grown past the need for such limits. If your next action is to Cast a Spell of 5th rank or lower that has no duration, you don't expend the prepared spell as you cast it.

items.name: Backup Runic Enhancement
items.prerequisites: trained in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion
items.summary: While you are not a spellcaster, you have a working knowledge of the most fundamental runic magic.
items.description: While you are not a spellcaster, you have a working knowledge of the most fundamental runic magic. You can cast the Sigil cantrip as an innate spell at will. In addition, choose either Runic Body or Runic Weapon. You can cast this spell once per day as an innate spell. The rank of these spells is equal to half your level, rounded up, and the tradition can be any tradition for which you are at least trained in the related skill (Arcana for arcane, Nature for primal, Occultism for occult, and Religion for divine).
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Backup Runic Enhancement

items.name: Engraving Strike
items.summary: You draw a rune onto the surface of your weapon in reverse, the mark branding or bruising itself into your target at the moment of impact.
items.description:
**Requirements** You are wielding a melee weapon.

You draw a rune onto the surface of your weapon in reverse, the mark branding or bruising itself into your target at the moment of impact. Make a melee strike with the weapon. On a success, you Trace a Rune onto the target of the Strike.

items.name: Glyph Familiar
items.summary: You have taken a living rune as a familiar to aid you in your adventures.
items.description: You have taken a living rune as a familiar to aid you in your adventures. You gain a familiar. You choose one familiar or master ability per day instead of two, but your familiar also always has three additional familiar abilities: construct, flier, and tough.

items.name: Remote Detonation
items.summary: You whisper an invocation over your ammunition as you shoot it, and the hissing of the projectile sounds just like your murmured voice.
items.description: You whisper an invocation over your ammunition as you shoot it, and the hissing of the projectile sounds just like your murmured voice. Make a ranged Strike that uses physical ammunition against a target within the first range increment of your weapon. If it hits, you Invoke Runes on the target as whisper of the ammunition's flight sets off the runes. You can invoke up to two runes this way, but all the runes must be on the target of your Strike. On a critical hit, the target takes a –1 circumstance penalty on any saving throws against the runes invoked by your Remote Detonation.

items.name: Rune Ward
items.summary: You quickly sketch a rune in the air to gain a modicum of protection against the triggering magic.
items.description:
**Trigger** You are targeted by a spell.

**Requirements** You are trained in the skill associated with the tradition of the triggering spell (Arcana for arcane, Nature for primal, Occultism for occult, and Religion for divine).

You quickly sketch a rune in the air to gain a modicum of protection against the triggering magic. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your saving throw and AC against the spell.

items.name: Rune-Singer
items.summary: You practice the lost art of using music to guide your rune-carving, singing the runes into existence as much as crafting them.
items.description:
You practice the lost art of using music to guide your rune-carving, singing the runes into existence as much as crafting them. You can use Performance instead of Crafting when attempting Crafting checks related to runes.

Once per 10 minutes, you can Trace a Rune with song alone. When you do, you use the 2-action version of Trace Rune as a single action without needing an artisan's toolkit, and you remove the action's manipulate trait. You don't need to be able to move your hands when Tracing a Rune using song, but you do need to be able to sing in a clear voice.

items.name: Seek the Hidden Glyphs
items.summary: You are well-versed in the use of magical runes in traps and hazards.
items.description:
You are well-versed in the use of magical runes in traps and hazards. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to find magical traps. Even if you aren't Searching, you get a check to find magical traps that normally require you to be Searching. You still need to meet any other requirements to find the trap. As long as you are holding or wearing an artisan's toolkit, you can use Crafting instead of Thievery to disable a magical trap (Disable Device), treating your proficiency in Crafting as your proficiency in Thievery for requirements.

In addition, if you trigger a trap by critically failing a check to Disable it, you can Trace a Rune on yourself as a reaction, gaining the benefits of the rune before the trap affects you.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Seek the Hidden Glyphs

items.name: Smithing Weapons
items.summary: Though you are an artisan, you are well versed in using the tools of your trade to fend off enemies.
items.description: Though you are an artisan, you are well versed in using the tools of your trade to fend off enemies. While wielding a weapon in the hammer, knife, or pick weapon group, you can use that weapon to etch runes without an Artisan's Toolkit. Additionally, a Strike with a hammer, knife, or pick deals 1 additional fire damage to an enemy bearing one of your runes as sparks fly on impact like a hammer to an anvil.

items.name: Enhanced Glyph Familiar
items.summary: Your living rune is imbued with more magical power.
items.description: Your living rune is imbued with more magical power. You can select two familiar or master abilities each day instead of one. In addition, when you Trace a Rune with a single action, your target can be adjacent to your familiar instead of adjacent to you. Your familiar must be within 30 feet of you for this benefit.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Enhanced Glyph Familiar

items.name: Fortifying Knock
items.summary: Your shield is a natural canvas for your art.
items.description:
**Requirements** You are wielding a shield.

Your shield is a natural canvas for your art. In one motion, you Raise a Shield and Trace a Rune on your shield.

items.name: Invisible Ink
items.summary: After your rune is drawn, it flares once and then fades, leaving only the barest mark.
items.description: After your rune is drawn, it flares once and then fades, leaving only the barest mark. When you apply a rune on an object or creature, you can Conceal an Object as a free action to hide that rune. If a creature would get a chance to find the rune, the GM uses your Crafting DC instead of your Stealth DC.

items.name: Pattern Flight
items.summary: You place a bit of magic in a physical projectile, causing it to fly in a runic pattern through the air once you loose it.
items.description: You place a bit of magic in a physical projectile, causing it to fly in a runic pattern through the air once you loose it. Make a ranged Strike against a target within your weapon's first range increment. Because of the erratic nature of its flight, this Strike ignores any circumstance bonus to AC from cover. After your Strike, you can Trace a Rune on one target in a straight line between you and the target of your Strike (including the original target).

items.name: Runic Tattoo
items.summary: By drawing your favorite rune in your flesh, you know you'll never be without it.
items.description:
By drawing your favorite rune in your flesh, you know you'll never be without it. Choose one rune you know, which you apply as a tattoo to your body. The rune is always etched on your body and does not count toward your maximum limit of etched runes. You can invoke this rune like any of your other runes, but once invoked, the rune fades significantly and is drained of power until your next daily preparations.

You can magically alter your runic tattoo to change it to another rune you know (or remove it altogether) with 1 day of downtime.

items.name: Artist's Attendance
items.summary: Your runes call you to better attend to your art.
items.description: Your runes call you to better attend to your art. Stride twice. If you end your movement within reach of a creature that is bearing one of your runes, you can Trace a Rune upon that creature or another target adjacent to you. You can use Artist's Attendance while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

items.name: Ghostly Resonance
items.summary: Your runes don't just draw power from the world of the spirits—they can let even the most mundane objects harm spirits as well.
items.description: Your runes don't just draw power from the world of the spirits—they can let even the most mundane objects harm spirits as well. When you etch or trace a divine or occult rune on a weapon or creature, you can grant it the Ghost Touch weapon property rune. For a weapon, this doesn't count toward the weapon's limit on property runes. For a creature, the rune applies to all unarmed Strikes the creature makes. This benefit lasts as long as the rune remains.

items.name: Song of Glorious Invocation
items.summary: You weave the true names of several runes you've drawn into a beautiful song, invoking them all simultaneously.
items.description:
**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

You weave the true names of several runes you've drawn into a beautiful song, invoking them all simultaneously. Choose up to three rune-bearers within 30 feet and Invoke one Rune on each of them. The song also inspires the rune-bearers, granting them a +1 status bonus to skill checks and saves against fear effects for 1 minute.

Effect: Song of Glorious Invocation
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Song of Glorious Invocation

items.name: Terrifying Invocation
items.summary: You spit and roar as you pronounce your rune's terrible name.
items.description: You spit and roar as you pronounce your rune's terrible name. You attempt to Demoralize a single target within 30 feet and then Invoke one Rune upon that target. You don't take a penalty to your check if the creature doesn't understand your language.

items.name: Transpose Etching
items.summary: With a pinching gesture, you pick up a word and move it elsewhere.
items.description: With a pinching gesture, you pick up a word and move it elsewhere. You move any one of your runes within 30 feet to a different eligible target within 30 feet.

items.name: Writing On the Wall
items.prerequisites: expert in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion
items.summary: You place hidden messages written in a runic cipher of your devising.
items.description:
You place hidden messages written in a runic cipher of your devising. You can cast Embed Message once per day as an innate spell. The rank of this spell is equal to half your level, rounded up, and the tradition can be any tradition for which you are at least expert in the related skill (Arcana for arcane, Nature for primal, Occultism for occult, and Religion for divine). When you cast *embed message*, instead of choosing a language you know for the message's text and speech, you can choose to have the message be text only, written in a runic code that only you know. You can impart the knowledge of this code to up to 5 creatures over the course of 10 minutes; they retain this knowledge indefinitely, but you can devise a new runic code for subsequent messages you wish to be encoded.

A creature can Decipher the Writing of your runic code using the same skill associated with the chosen tradition against your class DC.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Writing On the Wall

items.name: Diacritic Fluency
items.summary: When you intensify your attention, you can modify a rune with great speed.
items.description:
**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

When you intensify your attention, you can modify a rune with great speed. The next time you Trace a Rune this turn, you can also Trace a diacritic Rune on that rune.

items.name: Engraving Maneuver
items.summary: After quickly drawing a rune on your weapon, you can transfer the rune to a foe as you knock them down, push them away, or disarm their weapon.
items.description:
**Requirements** You are wielding a melee weapon with the disarm, shove, or trip trait.

After quickly drawing a rune on your weapon, you can transfer the rune to a foe as you knock them down, push them away, or disarm their weapon. Attempt to Disarm, Shove, or Trip a target; your weapon must have the corresponding trait. If your skill check is successful, you Trace a Rune onto the target of the Strike even if the target is pushed out of range.

items.name: Runic Reprisal
items.summary: When you Raise your Shield, you can bury a runic trap into it, which is set off by the clash of an enemy weapon.
items.description: When you Raise your Shield, you can bury a runic trap into it, which is set off by the clash of an enemy weapon. When you use Fortifying Knock, you can Trace a Rune with a damaging invocation on your shield, even if it normally couldn't be applied to a shield. The traced rune doesn't have its normal effect, instead fading into your shield. If you Shield Block with the shield against a melee Strike, you can Invoke the Rune as part of the reaction, causing the rune to detonate outward and apply its invocation effect to the attacking creature.

items.name: Tracing Trance
items.summary: Your hands flow unbidden, tracing runes as if by purest instinct.
items.description:
**Trigger** Your turn begins.

Your hands flow unbidden, tracing runes as if by purest instinct. You become quickened until the end of your turn and can use the extra action only to Trace a Rune (including to supply 1 action if using the 2-action version of Trace Rune). Focused on the act of creation, you can't use invocation actions this turn.

items.name: Vital Compound Invocation
items.summary: You can invoke runes from traditions that manipulate vital energy to restore flesh.
items.description: You can invoke runes from traditions that manipulate vital energy to restore flesh. You Invoke two Runes—one must be a divine rune, and one must be a primal rune. In addition to the runes' normal effects, one creature that's within 30 feet of both invoked runes regains Hit Points equal to 5 + double your level (level-based).
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Vital Compound Invocation

items.name: Words, Fly Free
items.summary: Just because your runes are tattooed on your very body doesn't mean they need to remain there.
items.description:
**Requirements** Your Runic Tattoo is not faded.

Just because your runes are tattooed on your very body doesn't mean they need to remain there. You fling your hand out, the rune from your Runic Tattoo flowing down it and flying through the air in a crescent. You Trace the Rune onto all targets within a 15-foot cone that match the rune's usage requirement. The rune then returns to you, faded.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Words, Fly Free

items.name: Drawn In Vital Ink
items.summary: After striking the target, you run a brush or finger along your weapon to collect a bit of its blood.
items.description:
**Requirements** During your last action, you succeeded at a melee Strike that dealt physical damage to a creature that can bleed.

After striking the target, you run a brush or finger along your weapon to collect a bit of its blood. For the next minute, you can Trace a Rune targeting the creature you drew blood from at a range of 60 feet (even if you're Tracing a Rune as a single action). Using Drawn in Vital Ink against a different creature requires you to wipe off the blood already on your weapon, ending the effect for the previous creature.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Drawn In Vital Ink

items.name: Edifying Trace
items.summary: When you apply a rune to a foe, it reveals something about them to you.
items.description:
When you apply a rune to a foe, it reveals something about them to you. Trace a Rune onto an adjacent enemy and then attempt a skill check to Recall Knowledge about that target. If you succeed, you leverage this knowledge when you invoke any of your runes on that target; that target takes a –1 status penalty to saving throws against your invocations for 1 minute.

If you use Edifying Trace on another enemy, the effect ends for the previous enemy.

items.name: Elemental Revision
items.summary: You can scratch out and rewrite part of an elemental rune to temporarily change the type of power it channels.
items.description: You can scratch out and rewrite part of an elemental rune to temporarily change the type of power it channels. You touch an adjacent Corrosive, Flaming, Frost, Shock, or Thundering rune on an unattended item or one held or worn by a willing creature, and you change it to any other rune from that list. You can also revise the greater version of any of the above runes into the greater version of any other rune on the list (for instance, Greater Corrosive into Greater Frost). The revision lasts for 1 minute before the rune's original magic reasserts itself.

items.name: Swiping Trace
items.summary: You prepare a rune on the end of your weapon so that it transfers to your enemies.
items.description:
You prepare a rune on the end of your weapon so that it transfers to your enemies. Make a melee Strike and compare the attack roll to the AC of up to two enemies within your melee reach. Roll damage only once and apply it to each creature you hit. You can Trace a Rune on each creature you hit and deal damage to, but they must be the same rune. A Swiping Trace counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty.

If you're using a weapon with the sweep trait, its bonus applies to your Swiping Trace attack.

items.name: Chain of Words
items.summary: You see the thin lines of magic between your creations, and you can exploit that connection with a small shift of power from one rune to another.
items.description:
**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

You see the thin lines of magic between your creations, and you can exploit that connection with a small shift of power from one rune to another. You Invoke two Runes within 60 feet. In addition to the runes' normal effects, a chain of glowing script flows between them, dealing level-based force damage to all creatures in a straight line between them with a basic Reflex saving throw; creatures bearing the invoked runes are not in the area of this line. A creature who critically fails its save is also immobilized for 1 round or until it Escapes, as the runes seal its movements. The DC to Escape is your class DC. At 12th level, and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d6.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Chain of Words

items.name: Clashing Compound Invocation
items.summary: As you invoke runes from disparate traditions of magic, their diametrically opposed effects repel each other in a destructive backlash.
items.description:
As you invoke runes from disparate traditions of magic, their diametrically opposed effects repel each other in a destructive backlash. You Invoke two Runes, which must be from opposed traditions of magic; either 1 arcane and 1 divine rune, or 1 occult and 1 primal rune. In addition to the runes' normal effects, one creature within 30 feet of both invoked runes must also attempt a Fortitude saving throw as destructive magical harmonics clash.

**Success** The target is Sickened 1, but if it spends a single action attempting to recover, it automatically succeeds.

**Failure** The target is sickened 1.

**Critical Failure** The target is Sickened 2.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Clashing Compound Invocation

items.name: Overloaded Ammunition
items.summary: You can tenuously bind power into arrows or sling stones to transform them into explosive missiles.
items.description:
You can tenuously bind power into arrows or sling stones to transform them into explosive missiles. During your daily preparations, you can lay power-containing runes upon two pieces of mundane ammunition to transform them into Explosive Ammunition. The DC of the *explosive ammunition* is equal to your class DC. The binding on the powder is unstable, and the ammunition burns itself to ash by your next daily preparations if not used. This ammunition has no value if sold.

At 14th level, you create Greater Explosive Ammunition instead.

items.name: Prodigal Rune-Singer
items.summary: You have mastered the art of singing your runes.
items.description: You have mastered the art of singing your runes. You can Trace a Rune with song once per round instead of once per 10 minutes.

items.name: Runic Correspondence
items.prerequisites: master in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion
items.summary: You can write a message that travels long distances at the speed of thought.
items.description:
You can write a message that travels long distances at the speed of thought. Once per day, you can take 1 minute to write a message of 25 words or fewer anywhere that can, at least momentarily, hold writing (such as on a piece of parchment, drawn in the sand, or lightly scratched onto soft metal). When you are finished, mentally picture one creature you know well. If the target creature is on the same plane as you, your message appears in their line of sight on any surface that can hold writing. It can be seen by only the target, and the target can read the message even if you don't share a language. The message disappears once the target reads it, but the creature can respond by spending 1 minute to write their own message of 25 words or fewer in the same way. You instantly receive that message when it is finished, and you can read it even if you don't share a language.

If you spend 10 minutes writing your message instead, you can include a rune from your runic repertoire. If the target is willing, after reading your message, you Trace the Rune on the target to last for up to 10 minutes. When you receive the creature's reply, you can Invoke that Rune as a free action.

items.name: Astral Compound Invocation
items.summary: Invoking runes from two schools of magic that both manipulate the intangible realm of thought results in waves of mental interference that stagger your foes.
items.description:
Invoking runes from two schools of magic that both manipulate the intangible realm of thought results in waves of mental interference that stagger your foes. You Invoke two Runes; one must be an arcane rune, and one must be an occult rune.

In addition to the runes' normal effects, one creature within 30 feet of both invoked runes must attempt a Will saving throw.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected by the compound invocation.

**Success** The target is Stupefied 1 until the end of your next turn.

**Failure** The target is Stupefied 2 until the end of your next turn.

**Critical Failure** The target is Stupefied 3 until the end of your next turn.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Astral Compound Invocation

items.name: Distant Invocation
items.summary: Your connection to your runes stretches over even greater distances.
items.description: Your connection to your runes stretches over even greater distances. You add 30 feet to the range of any of your invocation abilities (typically increasing the range from 30 to 60 feet).

items.name: Expanded Glossary
items.summary: You have memorized more runes than many in your craft.
items.description: You have memorized more runes than many in your craft. Add two runes of 9th level or lower to your runic repertoire.

items.name: Orbiting Runestone
items.summary: You create a runestone that floats around you, and you Trace a Rune with a damaging invocation on it even if the rune could not normally be applied to an object.
items.description:
You create a runestone that floats around you, and you Trace a Rune with a damaging invocation on it even if the rune could not normally be applied to an object. The runestone has 10 Hit Points. Each time a creature successfully Strikes you, attempt a DC 11 flat. On a success, the runestone blocks the attack, so the attack first damages the runestone and then applies any remaining damage to you. If this damage reduces the runestone to 0 Hit Points, it explodes outward toward the attacker. If the attacker is within 15 feet, the rune etched upon the runestone invokes automatically, applying its invocation effect to the attacker. The attacker is the only one affected by the invocation, even if the rune could normally affect multiple creatures.

The runestone's magic is capable of maintaining the traced rune for up to 1 minute as it floats around you, at which point the rune fades and the runestone shatters. You can maintain only a single orbiting rune at any given time. If you try to create a second, the first one shatters.

items.name: Dance of Bloody Ink
items.summary: As you lash out, your weapon is your brush, wounds forming words of power in your target's flesh.
items.description:
**Requirements** You're wielding a melee weapon that bears a rune.

As you lash out, your weapon is your brush, wounds forming words of power in your target's flesh. You Invoke a Rune on a melee weapon you are wielding and Strike. Then, you can Step and Strike again with the same weapon. If the second Strike hits, you Trace a Rune onto the target of the Strike. Both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but you do not increase your penalty until you have made all your attacks.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Dance of Bloody Ink

items.name: Define the Canvas
items.summary: You produce rune-inscribed stones, which whirl in the air before darting away to form a perimeter for a runic canvas.
items.description:
**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

You produce rune-inscribed stones, which whirl in the air before darting away to form a perimeter for a runic canvas. The canvas is a 20-foot burst on the ground centered on a corner in your space. As long as you're in or adjacent to the canvas, you can Trace a Rune directly into the ground, which causes the rune to expand across the entire space, tracing it onto any number of eligible targets within the area. The canvas lasts for 1 minute.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Define the Canvas

items.name: Henge Gate
items.summary: You hold a rune in your heart and strike the earth, causing two standing stones to rise nearby, your chosen rune carved upon their surfaces and blazing in the air above them.
items.description:
**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

You hold a rune in your heart and strike the earth, causing two standing stones to rise nearby, your chosen rune carved upon their surfaces and blazing in the air above them. The stones each appear in an unoccupied 5-foot space within 30 feet of you and within 15 feet of each other. When you raise the henge gate, choose one rune that can be drawn on a creature to carve into the stones. If you or an ally makes a successful ranged Strike using physical ammunition and that attack passes through the henge gate, the ammunition gains that rune in flight and automatically traces it on the target. The henge gate lasts for 1 minute.

items.name: Unerring Runic Attraction
items.summary: Your runes act as beacons for your arrows and bolts.
items.description: Your runes act as beacons for your arrows and bolts. Make a ranged Strike against a foe you're aware of that's currently bearing a rune and within your first range increment. The ammunition homes in on your target, even going around corners. Your Strike doesn't require line of sight, ignores the target's concealed condition, and ignores all circumstance bonuses to AC granted from cover and shields.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Unerring Runic Attraction

items.name: By Your Name
items.summary: In a moment of inspiration, you understand the target perfectly, allowing you to craft a rune that draws effects to the target by their very name.
items.description:
**Frequency** once per hour

**Requirements** You must know the target's name.

In a moment of inspiration, you understand the target perfectly, allowing you to craft a rune that draws effects to the target by their very name. Attempt a Crafting check against a standard DC of the target creature's level. Regardless of the outcome, you can't attempt to use By Your Name against the target again for 24 hours.

**Critical Success** You understand the target's runic name and temporarily learn how to write their name as a special diacritic rune. This diacritic rune magnifies the effects of the base rune when targeting the named creature. When the rune is invoked, the target takes a –2 circumstance penalty to their saving throw against the effects of the base rune, and if the base rune deals damage, it gains a status bonus to its damage equal to half your level. The inspiration used to understand this diacritic rune fades quickly, and you forget how to use the diacritic rune after 1 minute.

**Success** As critical success, but the rune doesn't grant a bonus to damage.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: By Your Name

items.name: Maze of Runes
items.prerequisites: legendary in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion
items.summary: You can trap a foe in a twisting, extradimensional labyrinth of ever-shifting runes.
items.description: You can trap a foe in a twisting, extradimensional labyrinth of ever-shifting runes. You can cast Quandary once per day as an innate spell. The rank of this spell is equal to half your level rounded up, and the tradition can be any tradition for which you are at least legendary in the related skill. Instead of the usual skill checks to solve the puzzle, the target of your *quandary* can attempt a Perception check, a Society check to Decipher Writing, or a check in the skill related to the tradition of the spell. When you Sustain this spell, you can also Trace a Rune or Invoke one Rune on the target creature as if it were adjacent to you.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Maze of Runes

items.name: Return Unto Runes
items.summary: You attempt to deconstruct an incoming spell into its individual magical components, storing them temporarily as a rune.
items.description:
**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

**Trigger** An enemy targets you with a spell attack or other magical attack against your AC.

You attempt to deconstruct an incoming spell into its individual magical components, storing them temporarily as a rune. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses, the spell becomes sealed in a rune, which floats around you. Until the end of your next turn, you can Trace this Rune onto a creature as normal. This rune doesn't have an effect until it's invoked. When the rune is invoked, the rune-bearer is affected by the spell or magical attack captured in the rune. Make a check, using your class DC – 10 as the modifier against the rune-bearer's AC to determine the effects.
